qualification: incomplete: ordinary RECOVERY-GUI-LIMITS failed MAX-WIDGETS (110421 us delay) and MAX-RECORD (116786 us work) against 100000 us. Passing diagnostic attempts do not replace this result.

timing_investigation.next: Attribute restore and editor construction/population costs, preserve input/erasure oracles, make a measured implementation repair and rerun the ordinary 100-ms gate. Do not infer the cause of the original failure from passing instrumented runs.

review_repair: On global shutdown the supervisor may finish before the network client. Inspection completion now accepts both terminal worker flags instead of depending only on a cached flag from the last supervisor iteration. Pending inspection intent also prevents a stopped report before the next launch iteration. These were review findings, not reproduced test failures.
limitations: Ordinary maximum-input GUI timing failed two cases. Functional evidence and passing diagnostics do not qualify that mandatory gate; W-11 remains in progress.
Installed image/topology and maximum-input inspector responsiveness, human accessibility and desktop/lifecycle composition remain required; W-11 stays in progress.
Positive policy uses an unprivileged compiled helper fixture. Protected deployment and all five complete native release editions remain unqualified.
Windows host toolchain checks do not qualify execution on historical Windows.
Native SceneInspector batch assertions run inside its existing scalar case and are not counted as independent CTest cases.
Earlier attempts are preserved with their original implementation/dependency identities; they are not substituted for final checks.
Raw evidence locators are ignored local archives, not portable build dependencies.
